text:
how to never get the morning blues - a step by step guide

1. 430 am alarm

2. STAND UP. walk to coffee maker, hit "on."

3. put on gym clothes, brush teeth.

4. fuel - 4-5 spoons of greek yogurt with honey/almonds/bloobs/banana + pound 2 cups of coffee the same way Roosevelt had his: "strong enough to float a horseshoe."

*get everything ready the night before; clothes, coffee, yogurt, etc

**ur supposed to brush ur teeth before u eat btw. I was 35 when I learned this

6. 445 AM: go time.

walk to wherever u train... airpods, deep house at max volume (partial to Kolter - "Be Real" this wk), try not to shit ur pants

shadowbox, be a freak, give thanks to the Most High that ur healthy and able to train...many men want nothing more than what u have in this moment

reflect on how many people squander the gift of health...scribble down notes "write a post about morning blues, maybe itll help someone"

7. pray for ur family and pray for ur friends. leave ur enemies to God

8. 100 weighted burpees

if ur out of shape do 10x5 with no weight. if ur in shape, knock off sets of 10, 5 singles 5 doubles

guy on the right is boxer Mike Rashid, we're trying to get to his level. copy his form, I had to put myself in the mix bc otherwise u get the gerbil squad... "rashid is big so hes on gear, not natty, fake video" etc....the pale white 40-yr old finance guy DQ's ur excuses.

9. after 2-3 sets I promise whatever "morning blues" u thought u had will be gone...rando free-floating anxiety is nowhere to be found and ur left only with "shit I have to do today/this week" i.e. actual worries

if ur pouring sweat, gasping for air and crouching to catch ur breath, ur doing them right

10. 530-545 pack it up, eat, shower, start ur day...commute, kids, narcoterrorism, whatever u do in the AM

11. soon as u start work do the most painful/unpleasant task immediately. this is old advice but it works

12. once this all becomes habitual u can be "done" with most of ur day by 9-10. only thing left is to walk a few miles in the sun and u will sleep good and live forever.

13. go to bed 830-9
14. 430 alarm
15. STAND UP + press "COFFEE" button. this is really 99% of the battle, u aint getting back in bed after that.

after that, 3 day rotation, push, pull, legs. honestly, if day 2 is just "do 100 various pull-ups" and day 3 is "do 100 various squats," and u just keep running this 3-day cycle for 3-6 months, u will pack on a lot of muscle

God gave u all the equipment u need, those few exercises cover almost ur entire body, and u dont have to think about shit at 430 am except "did I do legs yesterday"

END: NO DAYS OFF

Do not take days off, it is much easier to wake up early and train 7 days a week than 3-4. 

When u sleep in, u fuck up ur body clock, ur jet lagged all day, u sleep poorly that night, and then u will snooze the alarm.

Guess what comes after that... 

"The Morning Blues"

in this case u deserve them. sometimes the blues are simply God's way of telling u need to do better.

to borrow a Theodore Roosevelt term, the Blues are what u get for "living a life of slothful ease."

If TR was knocking motherfuckers out in bar fights at age 23 and then forcing them to "disdainfully" facechug beers afterwards, I'm pretty sure u can get up at 5 AM and do some pushups.

Best way to dodge the morning blues...don't ever let the sun catch u sleeping.

God bless ☀️
